edge_cases.description: Concurrent first use of Clients._client from SDK worker threads (sync tools run via anyio.to_thread) creates boto3 clients from one shared, non-thread-safe Session with no lock
Bare subresource query keys (None values) render as ?key and the signed URL matches the sent URL
Missing credentials refuse before any network call for all four REST helpers
Non-XML / empty error bodies on S3 and IAM fall back to HTTP status and reason
Non-JSON error bodies from Stats/WACM fall back to raw text
Empty or invalid WASABI_MCP_READ_ONLY values keep the default or raise a clear ValueError
Non-UTF-8 bytes in clean() are base64-encoded instead of failing
Override endpoints with trailing slash are normalised
